statement: For S(n)=(3n-1)/2^v2(3n-1) on positive odd integers, let a be nonperiodic and K_d^-=L_-^d 1_units the complete homogeneous residue coefficient. If sum_d K_d^-(a)/(d+1)^(1/6) is not summable, the ordinary natural-number reciprocal indicator series of the actual positive odd unit ancestors of a is not summable.
